title: El modelo de Emilie: la sección
description: docs/quests/emilie.md § In the section. The side view of the ground under Poble Sec: landing in El suelo, a stake measured (the ground round it turns real), inside its borehole, down to Las gravas and Bajo la ciudad, and El fondo with El que no converge. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.g = window.gerard.game; window.at = x => g.modelo.walk(x);
for (const p of Object.values(g.modelo.run.patrols)) p.rest = 999; g.modelo.run.patrols['celdas-1'].x = 12;

steps.caption: Landing in El suelo: all of it a guess, the mesh in phosphor green, a patrol of celdas secas ahead
Measured: the ground round the borehole is real, and the patrol cannot step on it. The stake now offers «Entrar»
Inside the borehole: out of the model. «Bajar»
Going down: the section rises past the party
Las gravas: a finer mesh, the oscilaciones, and the borehole they came down by above
Bajo la ciudad: tunnels the model was told about, La pluma; two stakes measured here calibrate the model
El fondo: El que no converge waits
Its fight, staged in the gallery
